itens.trecho: Maravilhosamente épico. Alguns filmes são tão bons que simplesmente não envelhecem. São atemporais, como qualquer obra de arte. Este é um desses filmes, talvez um dos melhores filmes de todos os tempos e certamente um dos maiores e mais épicos filmes bíblicos de sempre.

Majestic in scope and story telling. The truth is, is that Ben-Hur deserved every award that was showered upon it. It's a titanic film both in structure and scope. It doesn't need me to go over old ground about how much the film cost to make, the number of extras, the number of sets and etc, it's now folklore that this film could have bankrupted MGM such…

It will probably be remembered for it's chariot race long after all of the rest of it has faded away, but this is more than just that. It is a story about friendship, religion, power and opportunity - it is also about sheer bloody-mindedness and cruelty. It resonates all the more because these are all human traits that abound in all of us to some extent.
